description: Device signing (#240): build the commit for a set of writes to the caller's own repository on its current root, without signing it. Returns the bytes the device must sign (the commit's DAG-CBOR without sig), the new blocks so the device can check what it signs, and a handle for net.openfederation.repo.submitCommit. Only for accounts with device signing on. The prepared commit is bound to the account and to the root it was built on, expires after 5 minutes, and an account may hold at most 8 at once.

main.description: Prepare an unsigned commit for the account's device to sign.

writes.description: As com.atproto.repo.applyWrites: { action: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete' (or $type com.atproto.repo.applyWrites#create etc.), collection, rkey (optional for create: a TID is chosen), value (create and update) }. createRecord, putRecord and deleteRecord are one-write batches.

handle.description: Opaque id of the prepared commit, for submitCommit.

prevRoot.description: CID of the commit this one follows (the repo's current root).

unsignedCommit.description: Base64 DAG-CBOR of {did, version: 3, data, rev, prev: null}: sign exactly these bytes with the DID's atproto key (secp256k1 or P-256, ECDSA over SHA-256, compact 64 bytes, low-S).

newBlocks.description: The new MST nodes and record blocks, { cid, bytes (base64) }, so the device can check the new tree holds exactly its writes before signing.

writes.description: Per write: { collection, rkey, uri, cid (create and update) }.

errors.name: DeviceSigningOff
errors.description: Device signing is not on for this account; write with com.atproto.repo.*.

errors.name: UseDedicatedEndpoint
errors.description: Records in this collection are written only through their dedicated endpoint.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: A delete names a record that does not exist.

errors.name: TooManyPendingCommits
errors.description: The account already holds the maximum number of prepared commits.

errors.name: ProbationLimit
errors.description: A new pseudonym reached its daily write limit.
